programme.title: Nawaitu

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd S3 Ep14
programme.desc: Why did Abraham Lincoln once step into the wrestling ring? What's the story behind a dog that ignited an international conflict? These are the strangest origin tales you've never heard.

programme.title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters S2 Ep10
programme.desc: The team zeroes in on the island of Bermuda-namesake of the Triangle-and one of the most infamous mysteries that helped establish the dark reputation of these waters.

programme.title: The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch S5 Ep10
programme.desc: After hearing incredible testimony about a UFO crashing on Skinwalker Ranch many years ago, the team makes a shocking discovery inside the rocky Mesa.

programme.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny S2 Ep07
programme.desc: Victory is often forged in the shadows. A French Resistance operative hides explosives in baguettes to cripple a Nazi factory, and Ukrainian forces deploy AI-guided drones to strike a Russian bomber fleet.

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd S3 Ep14
programme.desc: Why did Abraham Lincoln once step into the wrestling ring? What's the story behind a dog that ignited an international conflict? These are the strangest origin tales you've never heard.

programme.title: Swamp People S15 Ep04
programme.desc: Ronnie moves his lines into the cypress swamps but soon finds himself going toe-to-toe with the King of the Swamp. Ashley gambles on a journey deep into unfamiliar territory behind a locked gate.

programme.title: The UnXplained With William Shatner S8 Ep04
programme.desc: From colossal walls and giant stone tombs to temples carved from solid rock, how did ancient civilisations achieve feats of engineering that still defy modern understanding?

programme.title: Modern Marvels: WWII Ep02
programme.desc: From blasting through mountains, to building gigantic infrastructure across the sea, to the biggest battleship in history and iconic builds like the Pentagon, WWII engineering is a battle of scale.

programme.title: The UnXplained With William Shatner S3 Ep37
programme.desc: Throughout the world, there have been many sightings of bizarre creatures that cannot be explained by science. Is it possible that there are terrifying monsters, lurking in the shadows of planet Earth?

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd S2 Ep15
programme.desc: We've heard the tales of prison breaks, but these aren't your average escapes. From a man who frees himself all thanks to a fruit to a Soviet pilot that evades capture by stealing the enemy's plane.

programme.title: History's Greatest Mysteries S7 Ep11
programme.desc: Bruce Lee was the closest thing that we had to a real-life superhero. But when he is found dead at his peak at the age of 32, many don't believe the coroner's assessment. So, what or who killed Bruce Lee?

programme.title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters S2 Ep12
programme.desc: The team unveils the greatest mysteries of the Bermuda Triangle: its most perplexing vanished ships and planes, and the strange and powerful forces said to be behind the Triangle's deadly reputation.

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island S12 Ep11
programme.desc: As the Fellowship uncovers more of the mysterious structure in the swamp, artefacts within it suggest it could be a vault with a compelling history.

programme.title: History's Deadliest With Ving Rhames S1 Ep02
programme.desc: From epic ancient battles at Cannae and Agincourt to World War II's Battle of the Bulge and the Battle of Stalingrad, these are history's deadliest conflicts.
